name: DongGuan Winnerway Industry Zone LTD.
summary: DongGuan Winnerway Industry Zone LTD. engages in the real estate development business in China. The company engages in the development and operation of various real estate properties, such as houses, villas, apartments, parking spaces, shops, etc. It is also involved in the coal mining business; industrial zone development; environmental protection and recycling of renewable resources business; and hydropower project installation and maintenance business. DongGuan Winnerway Industry Zone LTD. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
